basic_info.description: Welcome to your dream home at 1834 38th Avenue in San Franciscos Sunset District. This classic mid-century Outer Sunset home offers 2,200 sq. ft. of interior living space per appraisal, with approximately 1,250 sq. ft. on the upper level and 950 sq. ft. on the lower level. Designed with a desirable tunnel entrance and a layout that balances comfort with functionality, the upper level features two bedrooms and one bath, a spacious living/dining room combination, kitchen, and breakfast room. The lower level provides three additional bedrooms and one bath, creating excellent flexibility for extended family, guests, or rental potential. Recent upgrades include fresh interior and exterior paint, new flooring in the kitchen and breakfast room, new carpeting upstairs, updated light fixtures, and a beautifully landscaped backyard with new fencing. The garage includes a convenient laundry area and one-car parking. Situated on a sizable lot, this home offers a manageable outdoor space ideal for gatherings or quiet enjoyment. Located just blocks from Ocean Beach, Golden Gate Park, Stern Grove, and the vibrant Noriega Street Corridor filled with shops, cafes, and restaurants. Easy Muni and freeway access further enhance the appeal of this classic Sunset residence.
